data.name: Ira
data.gender_notes: Ira is used as a female name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit irā, 'earth, speech, the goddess Saraswati'. Its root is Sanskrit irā (इरा). A classical Sanskrit name. Ira is a Sanskrit name meaning “Earth; (also) the goddess Saraswati”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Ira expresses “Earth; (also) the goddess Saraswati”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Sanskrit irā, 'earth, speech, the goddess Saraswati'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ira total 19, reducing to 1. Number 1 is associated with leadership, independence and initiative.
